decision.title: createOrder payment input is one typed input object
decision.question: NewOrder.payment is a card or a bank account (oneOf). How should createOrder take it?

choices.label: one input Lumen_Books_PaymentInput {type!, last4, brand, iban}, sent as payment
two optional arguments, cardPayment and bankPayment, one of which is sent

resolution.note: Mirrors the output shape chosen in D-rvl036; GraphQL has no input unions, and one input keeps the body a straight copy of the argument. Body ids (customerId, items.bookId) are ID: the router sends the literal the caller writes, so a caller must pass them as strings, which the spec requires.
